station.name: Cape Town (Cape Town International Airport)
station.service: Japan Meteorological Agency, World Climate normals (WMO CLIMAT based), period 1991-2020
station.note: JMA page gives only monthly mean temperature and precipitation; the period 1991-2020 is stated on the JMA normals index page (https://ds.data.jma.go.jp/cpd/monitor/nrmlist/index.html). No South African Weather Service 1991-2020 normals for a Stellenbosch station could be found or fetched. Station about 10 km west of the atlas outline's western edge (bbox west 18.708).
station.crosscheck: weatherandclimate.eu/climate/68816 (no period or source stated) gives similar monthly precipitation 9,10,13,40,61,92,85,72,44,28,25,13 and means 21.8..12.7; consistent, not used.

derived_code: annual_rain=sum(rain); may_aug=sum(rain[4:8]); oct_apr indices [9,10,11,0,1,2,3]: rain sum and mean of monthly means; shares = SAWIS cultivar ha / 11815 *100; red_share=7562/11815; relief=1593-10

grapes.source: SAWIS, SA Wine Industry Statistics 2023 (NR 48), section 5.8 'Wine grape cultivars per wine region for 2023', p.12; section 5.2 p.8; section 5.6/5.7 p.11-12
grapes.note: SAWIS 'Stellenbosch' is a statistical wine region; used as the district figure. Cultivar rows sum to 11,815.

atlas.atlas_note: between the Simonsberg, Helderberg and Jonkershoek mountains; granite and sandstone soils

study.lesson: Southern Hemisphere path, lesson 'South Africa: Wine of Origin and the Cape'
facts: Stellenbosch is a district of the Coastal Region; wards include Simonsberg-Stellenbosch, Jonkershoek Valley, Banghoek
breezes from False Bay cool the vineyards
soils on the slopes mostly granite-derived, sandstone elsewhere
Pinotage = Pinot Noir x Cinsaut, Abraham Perold, 1925, Stellenbosch University
Chenin Blanc is South Africa's most planted grape
WSET bands: cool up to about 16.5, moderate 16.5-18.5, warm 18.5-21 C

hook: Southern Hemisphere study path (no event). Title hook 'Cabernet under the mountains': Cabernet Sauvignon is the most planted grape (SAWIS 2023), mountains per atlas note.

quiz.q: Which grape is most planted in Stellenbosch?
Pinotage is Pinot Noir crossed with...
When does most of the rain fall?
quiz.answer: B, May to August (62% of the year at Cape Town airport)
